# Light, measured with purpose.

<p class="hero-lead">An electronic-measurement laboratory specialized in optical and optoelectronic instrumentation.</p>

<p class="hero-context">Led by Prof. Luigi Rovati, OptoLAB designs, builds and characterizes optical measurement systems for biomedical, ophthalmic and environmental applications, bringing together optics, electronics, embedded systems and computation across the whole measurement chain.</p>

::: {.section-intro}
<p class="eyebrow">Research</p>

## What we investigate

We treat optical measurement as a connected chain, from optical interaction and sensor response to electronic acquisition and computational interpretation. Our activity spans ophthalmic instrumentation, biomedical optical imaging, wearable and spectral sensing, embedded acquisition and computational imaging.

[Explore our research →](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::
